# Linguin AI

Linguin AI detects languages and scores English text for profanity through its direct v2 API.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/linguin-ai/.

## Actions

- **Check Profanity** (read-only): Score the likelihood of profanity in one English text.
- **Check Profanity in Batch** (read-only): Score profanity likelihood for multiple English texts in one request and return scores in input order.
- **Detect Language** (read-only): Identify probable languages for one text and return candidates with confidence scores.
- **Detect Languages in Batch** (read-only): Identify probable languages for multiple texts in one request and return results in input order.
- **Get Account Status** (read-only): Return today's detection usage, daily limit, and remaining detection quota for the connected account.
- **List Supported Languages** (read-only): Return the complete map of language codes supported by language detection, including English and native names or aliases.
